About File Atlas

File Atlas is a graphical front end for the read-only file slice of the deterministic omni interface. It parses complete commands through a reviewed alias catalog and keeps parsing separate from file access.

A collision displays every ranked meaning and an explicit replacement command. Scores are ordering evidence, not probabilities. Choosing a local folder gives this page read access through the browser; the application has no upload or mutation adapter.
